identityScope: Four existing catalog rows in the cleaning category that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Xiaomi overview and specification pages. Robot Vacuum 5 Pro, X20 Max, X20 Pro and S20 are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Xiaomi company focus review exists. The 5 Pro page publishes 20,000 Pa suction, a retractable dToF radar reaching 9.5 cm clearance, an RGB camera with two infrared cameras and an infrared 3D dot projector recognising more than 200 objects and 47 dirt types, 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, 3.97 kg, a 350 mm by 88 mm body, a 4 L clean water tank covering up to 400 m2 and a dock measuring 470 x 360 x 572 mm with ramp extension. The X20 Max page publishes 8,000 Pa, a 2 mm edge reach with about 40 mm mop extension, 120 minutes, 3.9 kg, a 350 mm by 97 mm body, a 4 L clean water tank covering up to 200 m2 and a 340 x 420 x 563 mm station. The X20 Pro page publishes 7,000 Pa, 160 minutes, 3.7 kg, a 350 mm by 97 mm body, 4 L plus 3.8 L water tanks covering up to 120 m2 and a 340 x 420 x 563 mm station. The S20 page publishes 5,000 Pa, 3.5 kg, a 325 mm by 98 mm body, a 3200 mAh nominal battery, a 400 mL dustbin with a 270 mL water tank and a 146 x 122 x 98 mm charging dock. No reviewed page publishes a price, so all four catalog prices are cleared; the catalog X20 Max mass and run time are replaced by 3.9 kg and 120 minutes, and the catalog S20 run time is cleared because the pages publish no minutes.
